description: This file imports functions and variables from other modules to configure Vitest testing environment for a specific extension. It provides functions to load include patterns from environment variables and to create a scoped Vitest configuration for extension messaging tests.

methods.name: export function loadIncludePatternsFromEnv( loadIncludePatternsFromEnv
methods.description: Loads include patterns from environment variables or defaults to undefined if not present.

methods.name: export function createExtensionMessagingVitestConfig( createExtensionMessagingVitestConfig
methods.description: Creates a Vitest configuration for extension messaging tests with specific patterns and setup files.
